en: “No problem. This last one is perfect!”
“They definitely won't notice.”
“Wonderful!”
“—Thanks to you.”
“If it was just up to me, I wouldn't be able to pull this off.”
“It's not like that. This is all your hard work paying off, Kasumi.”
“It's just a question of time.”
“You just need to have more confidence in yourself. I'm just the housekeeper.”
“Hehe—that's true. It's not bad to have faith in yourself.”
“Do you really not need to tell them?”
“Ha, it's fine. I don't want my sisters to be a part of this.”
“But are you okay to be the bad cop?”
“I guess the point of being the bad cop isn't to have fun, is it?”
“Ah—yeah, you see—how was that for being the bad cop?”
“Really... Yeah... You got it.”
“What's happening today?”
“What's with all this food?”
“Hmmm... Today's a rare opportunity to show off how much you can eat!”
“You're not leaving us, are you?”
“What makes you ask that?”
“That's what happens in the TV shows, isn't it?”
“People always put all their effort in before they go away so that they leave the best possible impression.”
“Hey, don't talk like I'm about to die. Have a seat!”
“Alright...”
“But there really is a lot of food... and it's all our fav stuff.”
“Eat it, c'mon... Don't worry if you can't finish it, you can have it for lunch tomorrow.”
“Hmm. That's true—”
“Well then—Let's eat!”
Ayano&Shizuku
“What is it Kasumi?”
“Oh... Nothing. Yeah, let's eat!”
“Kasumi—play it cool...”
“I can't help it...”
“This is my first time making so much...”
“Don't worry, look at how they're wolfing it down.”
“If you act too unusually, they'll figure it out.”
“Th-That's true...”
“Shizuku, Ayano—”
“Just curious, how's the food today?”
“Wait—”
“Hmm, I don't know—♫”
“Cos' you're not the one who cooked it.”
“Eh?”
“Wh-What do you mean?”
“Yeah, is it good or not—*a-hem*!”
“Ha... Ayano don't mess with Kasumi.”
“Did Kasumi make this evening's meal?”
“How did you know?”
“It was obvious from the first bite.”
“You couldn't tell that... She seasoned it like I do. You couldn't taste the difference.”
“*pfffffft* Don't underestimate us.”
“Yeah, my sister's flavor is unmistakable.”
“Wait— What flavor is that?”
“...Is it that obvious?”
“Besides, Kasumi, why'd you wanna hide it?”
“Oh... that's...”
“You'd be better just saying that there was nothing worth mentioning...”
“Anyway, you just didn't want us to think that you made this, right, Kasumi?”
“You thought that just cos' you made it we'd shit talk it.”
“Oh my, that's sisters for you.”
“Let me repeat myself, I never felt like your food was that bad, Kasumi.”
“I mean, sometimes it looks a little weird.”
“That's true. I still remember those little fish were all charcoal, but they tasted good.”
“Hmmm... Who's side are you on exactly...”
“But that's no secret either. Isn't the most important thing that they're enjoying it?”
“If you didn't know what they were thinking then you'd struggle to make stuff they liked, wouldn't you?”
“...You're not wrong.”
“So let me ask again...”
“Shizuku, Ayano... Out of interest, how's the food today...?”
“Do you really need me to say—”
“Obviously {Me}'s is better!”
“That's not fair... Right now you should be—”
“But your food is good too, Kasumi.”
Ayano&Shizuku
“I mean you made this to make us happy.”
“How could we dislike it?”
“The problem is that you don't trust us, Kasumi.”
“We told you it was tasty way back when.”
“Yeah, you just expect too much from us, Kasumi.”
“Yeah, you mess stuff up sometimes.”
“But this evening's meal was actually really tasty.”
“...Kay, I see.”
“But I got a lot of help from {Me}.”
“But next time I'm gonna make something great all by myself.”
“Yeah, I'm excited!”
“You'd better make the most of having {Me} around and learn all you can from him!”
“I might need to get a raise.”
“Hehe. I need to learn all I can before next month.”
“Thank you.”
“This is all Kasumi's hard work.”
“The three of us have lived together since we were small.”
“And because of work, dad's hardly ever been around.”
“Although we always had housekeepers to do everything for us, sometimes we still went hungry between meals.”
“So I started to imitate the memory of our mother and cooked for them both.”
“And they ate toast with burned eggs... and still told me it tasted great.”
“Haha... When I think about it, that's when I got into cooking.”
“That was when... I didn't want them to go hungry any more so I decided to do more.”
“I see...”
“I guess you could say that they pushed your cooking in a strange direction, couldn't you Kasumi?”
“Haha—Maybe.”
“Anyway, seeing as I agreed, I'm gonna help you as best I can.”
“I'm hardly a professional, but I'll teach you everything I know.”
“Hmmm—then it's all on you.”
“But what in the world was that flavor they were talking about anyway?”
“Kasumi's special flavor... I didn't feel like your food tasted that different from mine.”
“I don't know—”
“Maybe you'll find out soon enough—teacher ♡”
“Don't be too hard on me, I really can't eat that much.”
“Hehe—♫”
